- [lacing.bodies.character_voice](_autosummary/lacing.bodies.character_voice.html.md): Body schema for per-character voice profiles — the shared voice vocabulary.
- [lacing.bodies.continuity_violation](_autosummary/lacing.bodies.continuity_violation.html.md): Body schema for continuity violations — generic, cross-media.
- [lacing.bodies.named_entity](_autosummary/lacing.bodies.named_entity.html.md): Body schemas for named-entity (NER) annotations.
- [lacing.bodies.reference_lock](_autosummary/lacing.bodies.reference_lock.html.md): Body schema for a &#42;locked reference&#42; — a first-class “this is canonical”.
- [lacing.bodies.review](_autosummary/lacing.bodies.review.html.md): Body schema for review notes — the edit-loop’s communication channel.
- [lacing.bodies.review_candidate](_autosummary/lacing.bodies.review_candidate.html.md): Body schema for review &#42;candidates&#42; — “this needs a human’s eyes”.
- [lacing.bodies.word](_autosummary/lacing.bodies.word.html.md): Body schema for word-level annotations (e.g., transcription, forced alignment).
- [lacing.cli](_autosummary/lacing.cli.html.md): Command-line interface for lacing.
- [lacing.digest](_autosummary/lacing.digest.html.md): Content digests over an annotation’s &#42;value&#42; — the freshness primitive.
- [lacing.exhibit](_autosummary/lacing.exhibit.html.md): Artifact exhibit — render an annotation graph as a readable document.
- [lacing.model](_autosummary/lacing.model.html.md): Annotation envelope, references, and provenance.
- [lacing.oplog](_autosummary/lacing.oplog.html.md): Operation log for time-travel debug + audit.

- [lacing.processors](_autosummary/lacing.processors.html.md): Background processors — pluggable jobs that run against a store + op-log.

- [lacing.store.memory](_autosummary/lacing.store.memory.html.md): In-memory annotation store backed by an interval tree.
- [lacing.store.migrations](_autosummary/lacing.store.migrations.html.md): Store-level schema migrations — the on-disk counterpart of the body ladder.
- [lacing.store.postgres](_autosummary/lacing.store.postgres.html.md): PostgreSQL-backed annotation store using &#96;int8range&#96; + GiST.
- [lacing.store.sqlite](_autosummary/lacing.store.sqlite.html.md): SQLite-backed annotation store and the &#96;.annot&#96; portable file format.
